response.overview: Documentation of Video Inn with three distinct segments. The first section documents the Women's Group watching videos in the viewing room at the Library and the resident cats walking through the space. The second section (starting at 16:21) Paul Wong in the kitchen preparing the communal dinner. The third section (starting 23:50) documents Shawn Preus describing the recent organization of the print library at Video Inn, and how they adapted Dewey Decimal system for the collection.
